job.title: Junior Observability & Telemetry Engineer
job.description: MetricWave Technologies in Noida specializes in distributed tracing and telemetry. We are looking for an early-career engineer proficient in OpenTelemetry (OTel), Prometheus, Jaeger distributed tracing, Grafana dashboards, and structured logging.

pool.text: OpenTelemetry (OTel): instrumented traces, spans, and metrics in distributed microservices
Prometheus & PromQL: crafted targeted alerts, rate queries, and histograms for service latency percentiles
Grafana Dashboarding: built interactive dashboards with variables, annotations, and alerting channels
Jaeger Distributed Tracing: analyzed cross-service latency bottlenecks and database call spans
TelemetryStack: docker-compose environment demonstrating end-to-end OTel collector, Jaeger, and Prometheus
B.Tech Computer Science, Shiv Nadar University, Noida, 2022–2026, CGPA 8.7/10
Structured JSON Logging: standardized log attributes (correlation ID, traceId, spanId) across services
Observability Intern at TraceCloud (Noida, 4 months): developed synthetic monitoring probes for critical APIs
Linux CLI: analyzed real-time performance using top, htop, vmstat, and iostat
Graphic Design: designed college newsletter banner in Canva
Docker & Container Monitoring: tracked cAdvisor container resource utilization metrics
